title: AutoFeatureTour tour (*.tour.json)
description: What to show: scenes of narration and steps. Names its platform; holds no URLs, credentials, launch commands or app-wide settings (stand-alone tours without "platform" may, for quick experiments).

$schema.description: This file's schema, for editors: a relative path to schemas/<type>.schema.json.

name.description: Run folder name (default: the file name).

env.description: Default environment (--target overrides; default: the platform's default).

fixtures.description: Fixtures from the platform's fixtures/: data ({data.x}), setup/teardown and off-camera steps.

story.description: The user story the tour verifies.

id.description: Ticket id, e.g. RMS-6142 (used in the run folder name).

items.description: One scene: narration over the steps that show it.

title.description: Shown on title cards and in reports.

narration.description: What the narrator says; the scene lasts as long as it does.

url.description: Path opened off camera just before the scene starts.

unresolved.description: Story items the generator could not map to the app; recording refuses until resolved.

todo.description: Work left for a person; recording refuses until removed.

action.description: Actions: finding and acting on an element (default 10000).

retries.description: Retries for actions that time out (default 1).

onError.description: "skip": an action that can't be done is skipped (checks still fail). Default fail.

hooks.description: Test data, off camera: setup before the browser starts, teardown after it closes (teardown runs whenever setup ran).

items.description: A setup/teardown hook, run off camera with BASE_URL and RUN_DIR set.

cwd.description: Working folder, relative to the file.

output.description: Use what it prints (or the HTTP response) as data: "json" (an object merged into data) or "text" (trimmed, as data.<as>). Setup hooks only.

node.description: Script path, relative to the file.

output.description: Use what it prints (or the HTTP response) as data: "json" (an object merged into data) or "text" (trimmed, as data.<as>). Setup hooks only.

optional.description: A non-2xx answer is only a warning.

output.description: Use what it prints (or the HTTP response) as data: "json" (an object merged into data) or "text" (trimmed, as data.<as>). Setup hooks only.

cwd.description: Working folder, relative to the file.

output.description: Use what it prints (or the HTTP response) as data: "json" (an object merged into data) or "text" (trimmed, as data.<as>). Setup hooks only.

node.description: Script path, relative to the file.

output.description: Use what it prints (or the HTTP response) as data: "json" (an object merged into data) or "text" (trimmed, as data.<as>). Setup hooks only.

optional.description: A non-2xx answer is only a warning.

output.description: Use what it prints (or the HTTP response) as data: "json" (an object merged into data) or "text" (trimmed, as data.<as>). Setup hooks only.

pronounce.description: Narration substitutions: written form → how to say it ("RMS": "R M S").

trace.description: false: no trace.zip (it holds network traffic and DOM).

allowMocks.description: Permit "mock" steps. Mocked responses are listed in the report; scenes a mock answered in get a "simulated data" caption. Refused for "style": "verification".

mocks.description: Mock sets from the platform's mocks/ folder, applied off camera before the first scene (needs allowMocks).

trimWaits.description: Long waits (page loads, busy indicators, waitFor, waitForResponse, dismissed known issues): cut them (default), speed them up, or keep them. The narration is never cut. --no-trim keeps them for one run.

trimWaitsOver.description: Only waits longer than this many seconds (default 1.5).

leadIn.description: Seconds of each trimmed wait that stay, so the cut is not jarring (default 0.3).

style.description: Generation hint (verification, demo, training); the engine ignores it.

draft.description: Generated with gaps; recording refuses unless --allow-draft.

baseUrl.description: Root URL of the app in this environment.
Root URL of the app in this environment.

data.description: Values for {data.<key>} in login steps, fixtures and tours (credentials: username, password…). Strings may use {env:NAME}. Environment data overrides the platform data; fixture data overrides both.

launch.description: Start the app if it isn't running: one service or a list.

anyOf.description: A service the run starts when nothing answers at healthUrl (already up: used as is, never stopped).

command.description: Shell command that starts it (run from the platform folder).

cwd.description: Working folder, relative to the platform folder.

env.description: Extra environment variables ({port} is the free port).

port.description: "auto" picks a free port per run ({port}).

healthUrl.description: URL that answers when it is up (default baseUrl; {baseUrl} and {port} allowed).

anyStatus.description: Any HTTP status counts as up (default: 2xx/3xx).

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for it (default 120).

stop.description: false: leave it running after the run (slow-starting services).

env.description: Extra environment variables ({port} is the free port).

anyStatus.description: Any HTTP status counts as up (default: 2xx/3xx).

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for it (default 120).

stop.description: false: leave it running after the run (slow-starting services).

attach.description: Attach-only: these must already be running.

items.description: A service the environment expects to be running; a run never starts it, and if it is down the run is UNREACHABLE.

anyStatus.description: Any HTTP status counts as up.

action.description: Actions: finding and acting on an element (default 10000).

ready.description: When a page counts as ready after an action, for apps that never go network-idle.

busy.description: CSS of busy indicators (spinners, skeletons); wait until none is visible.

stableMs.description: Then the page must not change for this long (default 1500).

timeout.description: Max wait for busy indicators to go (default 60000).

stableTimeout.description: Max wait for a stable page (default 15000).

strict.description: A page that never settles is an APP failure (default: a warning).

items.description: A known app or environment issue: what it looks like, what to do about it, how to report it. Tours never mention it; when the issue is absent nothing happens.

name.description: Unique name; reports say "known issue <name>". An environment rule with the same name refines the platform's.

comment.description: A note for people (why it happens, the ticket).

when.description: What the issue looks like: a locator (popup, panel, banner, toast), a failing request, or a console message / uncaught exception.

status.description: HTTP status: 503, "5xx", "4xx", or a list (default any failure).

anyOf.description: A console error or uncaught exception.

paths.description: Only on pages whose URL contains (or matches /regex/) one of these.

do.description: Steps that dismiss it (scoped to the matched element unless "scoped": false; its UI must be gone afterwards unless "noWaitAfter"), "tolerate" (leave it; it does not fail the step through errors / appErrors), or "hide" (CSS display:none: fakes the app's state, reported as such). Default tolerate.

as.description: warn (default: in the report, the run passes), fail (APP, exit 5: this known issue must not happen here), silent (report.json only).

times.description: At most this many firings per run; after that it is a normal error again.

noWaitAfter.description: After its steps, do not wait for the UI to go.

scoped.description: false: its steps search the whole page, not just inside the matched element.

off.description: In an environment: turn the platform's rule of this name off there.

workarounds.description: Known issues in this environment, merged with the platform's by name: a new name adds a rule here only; the same name refines it (partial entries are merged over the platform rule, "off": true disables it here).

text.description: Only when its text matches this regex.

appErrors.description: What browser-side errors during a step do: "fail" (APP failure) or "warn" (listed in the report).

ignore.description: Regexes of known noisy requests/messages: kept in network.json/console.json, marked ignored, never a cause.

mask.description: Blurred in the page before anything is recorded (video, screenshots, trace).
